qualifications: TTS is co-resident and uncontrolled; its activity, identity and query availability do not determine measurement admission. Performance reflects these actual shared-GPU conditions.

tts_identity_condition.scope: measurement condition, independent of service health and MO-Parse restoration

tts_no_calls_condition.limitation: start/end health and persistent-job counters are not atomic admission control; short calls without a persistent job may be unobserved

historical_native_conditions.scope: runtime measurement conditions only; not parser quality or corpus acceptance

shared_native_worker: initialization and warmup repeated in suite summaries describe the same worker, not additive costs
